full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman J : This petition by .the plaintiff-petitioners is directed against the judgment and order dated 24-5-93 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.7253 of 1991 (Dhaka) originally filed as Civil Revision No.663 of 1988 (Rangpur) discharging the Rule with modification after affirming the judgment and decree of the District Judge, Gaibandha in Other Appeal No.31 of 1987 arising from the judgment and decree of the Subordinate Judge, Gaibandha in Other Suit No.145 of 1985. 

 4. Both the trial Court and the lower appellate Court decreed the suit concurrently disbelieving the case of the defendant that the sale of the suit land was made for legal necessity. The learned Judges of the High Court Division also affirmed the judgment of the courts below with the modification that in view of the provision of section 205 of the Hindu Law alienation of the, suit land to the transferee Shibnath is valid during the lifetime of the transferor Patani Sundari Dassaya and the same will not be binding upon the plaintiff after her death.
